description: This file contains unit tests for the multimodal_response module, testing the save and get_bytes methods of AudioOutput, ImageOutput, and FileOutput classes.

classes.name: AudioOutput
classes.description: Represents an audio output with methods to save to a file and retrieve byte data.

classes.name: ImageOutput
classes.description: Represents an image output with methods to save to a file.

classes.name: FileOutput
classes.description: Represents a file output with methods to save to a file.

methods.name: test_audio_output_save_and_get_bytes(tmp_path)
methods.description: Tests saving audio data to a file and retrieving it as bytes.

methods.name: test_image_output_save_from_b64(tmp_path)
methods.description: Tests saving an image from a base64 string to a file.

methods.name: test_file_output_save_from_b64(tmp_path)
methods.description: Tests saving a file from a base64 string to a file.
